preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two space-separated integers R and C, each representing a positive integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.
R and C are integers satisfying 1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) <= 10**4 and all(c in {'L', 'R', 'U', 'D'} for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: stdout is a non-empty string of length at most 10^4, composed exclusively of the characters 'L', 'R', 'U', and 'D'.

postconditions.expression: all((obstacle_x, obstacle_y) != (0, 0) and 1 <= obstacle_x <= R and 1 <= obstacle_y <= C for obstacle_x in range(1, R + 1) for obstacle_y in range(1, C + 1))
postconditions.description: The sequence of instructions uniquely determines the obstacle position (X, Y) for every possible (X, Y) in the range 1 ≤ X ≤ R and 1 ≤ Y ≤ C, given the final cell of the robot after executing the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all((final_positions[(X, Y)] != final_positions[(Xp, Yp)]) or ((X, Y) == (Xp, Yp)) for (X, Y) in possible_obstacles for (Xp, Yp) in possible_obstacles if (X, Y) != (Xp, Yp))
postconditions.description: For every pair of distinct obstacle positions (X, Y) and (Xp, Yp), the final robot position after executing the sequence differs. Here, possible_obstacles = {(X, Y) | 1 ≤ X ≤ R and 1 ≤ Y ≤ C}, and final_positions[(X, Y)] is the robot's final cell when the obstacle is at (X, Y).
